description.zh: 异常告警通用配置模块中配置项的编码。可通过[DescribeConfigs](~~DescribeConfigs~~)获取配置项的Code。
description.en: The code of the configuration item in the anomaly alert general configuration module. You can call [DescribeConfigs](~~DescribeConfigs~~) to obtain the Code of the configuration item.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
- **zh_cn**：默认值，中文。
- **en_us**：英文。
description.en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
- **zh_cn**: Chinese. This is the default value.
- **en_us**: English.

descriptions.zh:
本接口一般用于根据异常告警通用配置模块中配置项的编码，停用用户配置，便于用户及时修改用户配置的生效状态。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation is used to disable a user configuration based on the code of a configuration item in the anomaly alert general configuration module, allowing you to promptly modify the effective status of the user configuration.

## QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 10 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation as needed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sddp disable-user-config --lang zh_cn --code access_failed_cnt --feature-type 2 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sddp DisableUserConfig --region cn-hangzhou --FeatureType 2 --Lang zh_cn --Code access_failed_cnt
